g.text: 1. Roof construction shall comply with BS 5534 and BS EN 1995-1-1 (Eurocode 5) — Timber structures.
2. All timber to be treated C24 graded — preservative treated to Hazard Class 2 (UC2).
3. Roof pitch: 30° to all slopes. Ridge board: 38×200mm. Rafter centres: 400mm max.
4. Underlay: breathable membrane to BS 5534 Class 1. Laid with 150mm lap minimum.
5. Insulation: 400mm mineral wool quilt between rafters + 25mm ventilated airspace at all times.
6. Lead flashing code 4 to all chimney junctions, valleys, abutments and roof penetrations.
7. Gutters and downpipes: UPVC half-round 150mm gutter, ø100 downpipe connected to soakaway.
